question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Web tools failed this run (API errors), so evidence comes from prior journal research records (Oct 7 and Oct 11 runs) citing the SEC 8-K, Admiral Markets, MarketBeat, Yahoo. Meta guided Q3 2026 revenue to $61-64B with a ~1% FX headwind; consensus is ~$63.2B. In 2026 both quarters landed ~$0.2B under the top of guidance (Q1 56.31 vs 56.5; Q2 60.80 vs 61), while 2025 beat the top by $0.5-2.0B. No escape mass: the quarter has ended and no mechanism takes revenue outside $61-67B.
